column1: # RomFS byte patches the host applies to a file's reads when the player picks the variant (DM_ROMFS_PATCH=<variant>; docs/reference/services.md, RomFS patches). A row replaces the bytes `old` at `offset` of `path` with `new` (same length, hex);
# it applies only where a read returns exactly `old`, so another build of the file is left as it is. Columns, separated by tabs: variant, path in the RomFS, offset in the file, old, new.

# Star Fox: data.zip's platform cvar member holds render.resolution_scale_console (Switch 2 value 0.5, so the scene is 960x540 of 1920x1080); the variant sets it, with the member's compressed block, CRC (local header, data descriptor, central directory) kept consistent.
# Made by comparing the original image with a clone patched by hand (dm/games/0400E88025B1A000/README.md).
